stories.title: Da The Pitt a Widow’s Bay, le serie premiate agli Emmy confermano scelte e passioni del pubblico

en.title: From The Pitt to Widow's Bay, Emmy-winning series confirm audience choices and preferences
en.summary: HBO and Apple TV received prominent recognition at the Emmy Awards, with Apple TV's high-budget premium productions standing out among the winners.

stories.title: Michael J. Fox commuove agli Emmy: "Accettare il Parkinson non significava arrendermi"

en.title: Michael J. Fox moves audience at Emmy Awards: "Accepting Parkinson's did not mean surrendering"
en.summary: Michael J. Fox received a standing ovation at the Emmy Awards and was honored for his research contributions against the disease diagnosed 29 years ago.

stories.title: Ranucci fa ricorso al tribunale dopo rimozione da conduzione Report

en.title: Ranucci appeals to court after removal from Report hosting
en.summary: A journalist has filed a legal appeal following his removal from hosting the Report program.

stories.title: Ranucci deposita un ricorso urgente contro la rimozione da Report

en.title: Ranucci files urgent appeal against removal from Report
en.summary: The journalist is requesting revocation of his removal and reinstatement in time for the program's first episode.

stories.title: Difesa, drone in Lituania abbattuto da caccia italiani

en.title: Defence, drone shot down in Lithuania by Italian fighter jets
en.summary: NATO sources are investigating a drone that was shot down over Lithuania by Italian aircraft, with suspicion it originated from Russia.

stories.title: Bonus colonnine, il 22 settembre via alle domande: le regole per il contributo fino a 8mila euro

en.title: Charging station bonus, applications begin September 22: rules for contribution up to 8,000 euros
en.summary: Italy is opening applications for subsidies supporting charging infrastructure installation, offering up to 1,500 euros for private individuals and up to 8,000 euros for condominium buildings through the Invitalia platform.

stories.title: Fregata russa lancia due bengala e sfiora elicottero danese. Caccia Nato abbatte drone su Lituania

en.title: Russian frigate fires flares and nearly hits Danish helicopter. NATO fighter shoots down drone over Lithuania
en.summary: A NATO fighter jet downed a drone over Lithuania while a Russian frigate fired flares near a Danish helicopter. Zelensky emphasized the need for security guarantees and a German politician warned of risks to European peace.

stories.title: Il complotto per forzare Lotito a vendere la Lazio: perquisiti i vertici di Banca del Fucino e il faccendiere Bisignani

en.title: Plot to force Lotito to sell Lazio: executives of Banca del Fucino and fixer Bisignani searched
en.summary: Prosecutors are investigating a suspected coordinated scheme involving social media campaigns, press articles, and contacts between bankers and journalists allegedly aimed at pressuring the Lazio club president to sell the team and manipulate its stock price.

stories.title: Ranucci fa ricorso urgente al tribunale: chiesto il reintegro alla conduzione di Report

en.title: Ranucci files urgent court appeal: reinstatement to Report leadership requested
en.summary: A journalist has filed an urgent legal appeal contesting insufficient justifications and demotion from his position.

stories.title: Michael J. Fox agli Emmy: “Tenni nascosto il Parkinson, temevo che il pubblico non avrebbe più riso”

en.title: Michael J. Fox at the Emmys: "I kept my Parkinson's hidden, I feared the audience would no longer laugh"
en.summary: Michael J. Fox received a humanitarian award at the Emmy Awards and disclosed that he initially hid his Parkinson's diagnosis due to concerns about losing his career and audience support.

stories.title: Bonus affitto fino a 500 euro per i genitori separati: bando in autunno, ecco chi potrà richiederlo

en.title: Rental bonus up to 500 euros for separated parents: application period in autumn, here's who can request it
en.summary: A rental subsidy program for separated or divorced individuals seeking new housing will launch in autumn with an annual fund of 20 million euros, with eligibility based on an income threshold of 35,000 euros.

stories.title: Lituania, jet italiani abbattono drone. Danimarca, razzi illuminanti contro elicottero da nave russa

en.title: Lithuania, Italian jets down drone. Denmark, flares against helicopter from Russian naval vessel
en.summary: Italian military aircraft destroyed a drone over Lithuania while Denmark deployed flares against a helicopter from a Russian ship, amid escalating tensions in the region.

stories.title: Spaggiari rileva Esds per crescere in America Latina e Penisola Iberica

en.title: Spaggiari acquires Esds to grow in Latin America and Iberian Peninsula
en.summary: Spaggiari, a platform company owned by Ambienta, is acquiring Esds to expand its operations beyond Italy into Latin America and the Iberian Peninsula.

stories.title: Welfare integrativo applicato dal 46% delle imprese liguri

en.title: Supplementary welfare adopted by 46% of Ligurian companies
en.summary: Nearly half of businesses in Liguria have introduced supplementary welfare initiatives beyond national collective agreements, with most planning to maintain or expand these programs.

stories.title: Terzo valico, via libera a 58 milioni per rigenerare tre quartieri a Genova

en.title: Terzo Valico project: €58 million approved for regenerating three Genoa neighborhoods
en.summary: Funding of 58.6 million euros has been approved for urban regeneration of three Genoa districts affected by the Terzo Valico railway project.

stories.title: Export avanti (+4,7%) anche a luglio. Boom di acquisti di auto dalla Cina

en.title: Italian exports advance 4.7% in July, boosted by auto sales to China
en.summary: Italian exports grew 4.7 percent in July following a 9.8 percent increase in June, with particularly strong growth outside the EU and notable demand for automobiles from China.

stories.title: Media, mercato in crescita spinto da streaming e web

en.title: Media, market growing driven by streaming and web
en.summary: The media market in Italy and abroad is expanding, with streaming and web services emerging as the primary drivers of growth.
